tips.hot: In hot weather, drink water before, during and after training, and avoid a stimulant pre-workout in the hottest hours of the day.
tips.humid: In humid weather you sweat more, so keep water or an electrolyte drink with you.
tips.ramadan: During Ramadan most people train after iftar. If you take a pre-workout, keep it away from bedtime, and drink enough water between iftar and suhoor.
tips.altitude: Training in high-altitude cities can feel harder. Start with a lower dose and give your body time to adjust.
tips.cold: In cold weather, take a longer warm-up before training.
tips.generic: Whatever your climate, start with half a serving and see how your body responds.

faq.a: The best one is the one that fits your caffeine tolerance and your training, with a label that lists what is inside. Promolecules offers several formulas, from ultra high-stim to non-stimulant.

faq.q: How long before training should I take it?
faq.a: Take it 20 to 30 minutes before training, and start with half a serving.

faq.q: Can I take pre-workout every day?
faq.a: It depends on your caffeine tolerance and how much caffeine you already have in the day. If you are unsure, ask a doctor.
It is for adults only. It is not recommended for children, pregnant women or breastfeeding women.
